definitions.gloss: coverage area; communication range; signal range
definitions.explanation: The geographic area within which a wireless device can send and receive signals. Used for mobile phones, radio, Wi-Fi, and other wireless communication.

examples.japanese: {通信圏|つうしんけん}⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}えない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: The phone doesn't work because it's out of coverage.
Deep in the mountains, you often can't get into a coverage area.

examples.japanese: ⟦トンネル→トンネル：03865_tonneru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}けて→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{通信圏|つうしんけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}り→戻る：01117_modoru⟧、⟦メッセージ→メッセージ：03828_messeeji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一斉|いっせい}→一斉：01726_issei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: After leaving the tunnel, I finally got back into coverage and all my messages came through at once.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{通信|つうしん}→通信：03514_tsuushin⟧ (communication, telecommunications) and ⟦{圏|けん}→圏：21183_ken⟧ (sphere, zone). Commonly encountered when traveling to remote areas or underground locations where mobile phone signals are weak or absent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通信圏|つうしんけん}⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧: out of range, out of coverage
- {通信圏|つうしんけん}⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧: within range, in coverage
- {通信圏|つうしんけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter a coverage area
- {通信圏|つうしんけん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{外|はず}れる→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧: to go out of coverage

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{圏外|けんがい}→圏外：07689_kengai⟧: out of range — the shorter, more casual term displayed on Japanese phones when there is no signal
- ⟦{圏内|けんない}→圏内：16392_kennai⟧: within range — the opposite of ⟦{圏外|けんがい}→圏外：07689_kengai⟧
- ⟦{電波|でんぱ}→電波：04070_denpa⟧: radio waves, signal — the physical signal itself
